learning_outcomes.text: To provide in detail the problems of melting and casting of foundry alloys.

syllabus_topics: Foundry production in the Czech Republic and worldwide
Foundries and market economy - the quality of castings, compared with forming technology
Production according to market needs, meet customer needs
Systematic approach to quality management, ISO 9000
Homogeneous and heterogeneous nucleation, constitutional supercooling
Crystallization of Fe and Al alloys
Volume changes during solidification and cooling
Solidification contraction, hot spots, shrinkage cavities
Feeding - types of risers, riser dimensions and shapes
Feeding distance, the size and number of risers
Main requirements on the gating system
Pouring time, choke area and gating ratios
Foundry iron alloys - their metallurgy and heat treatment
Foundry iron alloys - their metallurgy and heat treatment
Cast iron with a graphite červíkovitým
Classification of aluminum alloys according to IEC and EN
refining, treatment of the melt, degassing
silumin alloy - types, vaccination, modification, heat treatment
Other used alloys Al - use heat treatment
characteristic, occurrence and properties of magnesium
Production of metal magnesium and its consumption
Metallurgical and technological principles for magnesium
Reaction with magnesium alloy molding materials
Foundry alloy of zinc and copper
Copper alloys - types, principles of melting
Foundry alloys of titanium, tin, lead
